issues.title: Whole request body still goes to users.create
issues.explanation: Validation reads three fields but then passes req.body through, so a client can send role: "admin" or is_verified: true and have it stored.
issues.fix: Call users.create({ email, password, age }) with only the validated fields.

issues.title: age is not checked to be an integer
issues.explanation: Missing age, "abc" or 13.5 all pass because undefined < 13 and NaN < 13 are false. USR-77 requires an integer of 13 or over.

issues.title: Missing password throws instead of returning 400
issues.explanation: If password is absent or not a string, password.length throws a TypeError and the client gets a 500.
